findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facturin_preview_invoice, vira_request_access · Private data: peru_company_lookup, peru_company_search, vira_recommend_solution, facturin_preview_invoice, vira_request_access · Public sink: vira_request_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facturin_preview_invoice, vira_request_access · Private data: peru_company_lookup, peru_company_search, vira_recommend_solution, facturin_preview_invoice, vira_request_access · Public sink: vira_request_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "peru_macro_indicators" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Peru's key macroeconomic indicators by year: GDP, real growth, GDP per capita, inflation, unemployment,
    current account, public debt and population, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Years from the current one
    onward are IMF estimates/projections. Use it to assess Peru's economic stabilit" → after: "Peru's key macroeconomic indicators by year: GDP, real growth, GDP per capita, inflation, unemployment,
    current account, public debt and population, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Years from the current one
    onward are IMF estimates/projections. `recent_monthly` adds the last six months"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
